test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 8 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The total number of candidates qualified in 1997 and 1999 together was 53590 and the number of candidates appeared in 1999 was 43060. Candidates qualified in 1997 are what percentage (approximately) of the candidates qualified in 1999?
solution:
**Given:**

Total number of candidates qualified in 1997 and 1999 = 53590

Number of candidates appeared in 1999 = 43060

Percentage of candidates qualified in 1999 = 50%

**Formula used:**

Qualified candidates in 1999 = dfrac{Percentage}{100} times Appeared Candidates

Qualified candidates in 1997 = Total qualified in 1997 and 1999 - Qualified candidates in 1999

Required percentage = dfrac{Qualified Candidates in 1997}{Qualified Candidates in 1999} × 100

**Calculation:**

Qualified candidates in 1999 = dfrac{50}{100} times 43060 = 21530

Qualified candidates in 1997 = 53590 - 21530 = 32060

Required percentage = dfrac{32060}{21530} times 100

⇒ dfrac{32060}{21530} times 100 approx 148.9%

**∴ The candidates qualified in 1997 are approximately 149% of the candidates qualified in 1999.**
